name: fit.pair
repairs: in<j>.len = in<k>.len (map2.*, hist.*; .rows for map2_rows, histrows, rowdiv)
rendering: let ad_a = {k} let ad_b = {j} let ad_l = i64.min (length ad_a) (length ad_b) in <spelling with fit ad_l 0{E} ad_a and fit ad_l 0{E} ad_b as the two operands>

name: fit.state
repairs: a loop body's len against its state's
rendering: the body becomes fit {1.len} 0{E} ({2}); a ?-length state is first let ad_s = {1} let ad_m = length ad_s in, and the state is declared [ad_m]

name: fit.body
repairs: a lambda body's length against a size argument

name: fit.inner
repairs: an inner dimension (matmul, map2_rows, histrows columns)

name: fit.root
repairs: the entry's result against the signature's sizes
rendering: fit on each dimension, inner ones by map (fit ..)

name: subst
rendering: the node renders as its first input of its own data type, else as its data type's constant

name: subst.const
rendering: the node renders as its data type's constant (the histogram with nothing counted), whatever its inputs
